description: This visual was developed in partnership with Hamed Behairy - CFA.... one of top financial trainers in the world Hierarchical bar chart is a Power BI Custom Visual which displays hierarchical data (different fields having parent/child relationship) in the form of a bar/column chart with +/- signs to view/hide details or child elements. This visual has following key features 1) Expand/ Collapse bars using (+/-) buttons 2) Show variance between bars 3) Drag the bars for custom sorting 4) Click on legends to drill down/up to any level 5) Show targets All functionalities of this visual are available for free within Power BI Desktop. In Power BI Online Service, it will show a watermark. To use the visual without watermark in Power BI Online, please purchase license subscription. For more information visit https://www.excelnaccess.com/hierarchical-barchart/ Would love to hear from you.....(feedback, bugs, improvement suggestions, ideas etc).
